decisive_items: Symmetric annular brown erythematous plaques on the cheeks and temples
Positive: anti-Smith antibodies, SSA/Ro antibodies, SSB/La antibodies, and anti-U1RNP antibodies
response.rationale: R1 captures the characteristic annular plaques and specific autoantibodies (anti-SSA/Ro) typical of subacute cutaneous lupus erythematosus, while R2 only lists systemic lab abnormalities without the skin findings. R1 is more specific to the presentation.

rejected.why: Discoid lupus typically shows scarring, follicular plugging, and different histology; the presence of annular plaques and anti-SSA/Ro argues against DLE.
C1 is an append-only completion of R1, adding no new raw evidence beyond the antibody list already present in R1.
